437-4613-4644.easyPrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
437-4613-4644.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.

240-4460-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-4460-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

5078-5642-7356.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Longshot and Echoes of Eternity trigger.
Resolve the Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Echoes of Eternity trigger, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

529-4460-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

225-3129-4094-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-3129-4094-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

104-5641-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-5641-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-5645-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5645-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2018-4053-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Spore Frog from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Repeat.

640-7275-7509.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-7275-7509.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Gleeful Arsonist.
Gleeful Arsonist dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Gleeful Arsonist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Gleeful Arsonist, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

943-1460-4235.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
943-1460-4235.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Vault of Catlacan.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Vault of Catlacan
Repeat
943-1460-4235.notes: With excess mana, you can instead untap another land instead of Vault of Catlacan.

240-1115-4050-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1575-4231-4826-7313.description:
Activate a Food by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color due to Ninja Pizza.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating an untapped Food, Clue and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor and Archelos.
Repeat.
1575-4231-4826-7313.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Food to its native ability to gain life.

1453-2387-3490-7295.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-7295.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2557-3340-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

149-2757-3799--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing that much damage to the named player
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-2757-3799--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

250-779-1479-1669-2692.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-2692.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

5231-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-4241-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Karn.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-4241-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

56-4054-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4054-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-4054-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

624-6598.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phantasmal Image's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Repeat from step 2.

3750-5520-6473.easyPrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
3750-5520-6473.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3750-5520-6473.description:
Declare Mardu Siegebreaker as an attacker, triggering its second ability, creating a token copy of Rose Room Treasurer tapped and attacking each opponent.
When the Rose Room Treasurer tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger for each other token that entered the battlefield, and any other Rose Room Treasurer(s) you control trigger for each token that entered the battlefield.
Resolve a Rose Room Treasurer trigger, creating a Treasure token if its the first or second time that ability has resolved this turn, or choosing not to pay otherwise.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-5520-6473.notes: This combo only works as long as you have three or more opponents. Once you have two or less, it fails to make enough mana to sustain itself.

5755-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5755-6191.description:
Gain life.
Enduring Tenacity triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-2393-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Sifter of Skulls and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1525-1603-2031-2406-2660.notablePrerequisites:
Evil Twin is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-1603-2031-2406-2660.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-1603-2031-2406-2660.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

191-1742-4343-5476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
191-1742-4343-5476.description:
When an opponent controls an untapped creature, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Elvish Mariner triggers, causing you to tap an untapped creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw a card.
Elvish Mariner triggers, causing you to tap nothing.
Repeat as desired.

1736-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ponyback Brigade, adding {1}.
Ponyback Brigade dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Ponyback Brigade from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Ponyback Brigade enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Goblins, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1734-2034-4605-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Preston.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, choosing not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding {C}{C}.
The token dies, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2104-3554-4105.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Demonic Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Demonic Tutor and Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
